reader_summary.headline: David Lyon is Managing Director and Head of Capital Solutions at Neuberger Berman.
reader_summary.overview: David Lyon is Managing Director and Head of Capital Solutions at Neuberger Berman. Over three decades, David was the first arbitrage analyst at Och-Ziff in the mid 1990s. His experiences offer a deep understanding of both sides of the balance sheet, which he brought together in hybrid capital solutions over the last decade.

key_points.text: David Lyon is Managing Director and Head of Capital Solutions at Neuberger Berman.
Over three decades, David was the first arbitrage analyst at Och-Ziff in the mid 1990s.
Our conversation traces his journey, lessons learned along the way, and perspectives on today's private markets.
